summary: AXIA Energia S.A. (formerly Eletrobras) filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of a mandatory exchange of all outstanding class B1 preferred shares and ADSs into common shares/ADSs at a ratio of 1.1 common for each preferred share, effective June 10, 2026. The exchange was in connection with the company's migration to the Novo Mercado segment of B3. Common ADSs continue trading on NYSE under ticker AXIA. The company intends to terminate its reporting duty for the preferred ADSs. This is a corporate restructuring event, not a traditional special situation. The exchange eliminates dual-class structure, simplifying capitalization.
